questions.question: If sqrt x - (1)/({sqrt x )} = {sqrt 3 }, then what is the value of {x⁴} + (1)/({{x⁴)}}?
questions.solution:
**Formula:**

(x - y)² = x² + y² - 2xy

**Calculations:**

√x - 1over √x = √3

Squaring both sides, we get-

⇒ (√x)² + (1over √x)² - 2 × sqrt x × 1over √x = (√3)²

⇒ x + 1over x - 2 = 3

⇒ x + 1over x = 5

Squaring both sides, we get-

⇒ x² + 1over x² + 2 = 25

⇒ x2 + 1over x² = 23

Squaring both sides, we get-

⇒ x4 + 1over x⁴ + 2 = 529

⇒ x4 + 1over x⁴ = 527

**The answer for the expression is 527.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** If √x - 1over √x = √3 = p, then x + (1)/(x) = p² + 2 = (√3)² + 2 = 5 = k (Let)

If x + (1)/(x) = k = 5, then x² + (1)/(x²) = k² - 2 = 5² - 2 = 23 m (Let)

 x2 + (1)/(x²) = m = 23, then x⁴ + (1)/(x⁴) = m² - 2 = (23)² - 2 = 527

questions.question: The area of similar triangles PQR and MNT are 196 cm² and 169 cm² respectively. If the longest side of the larger Δ PQR be 28 cm then what is the length (in cm) of the longest side of the smaller Δ MNT?
questions.solution:
**Given data:**

Δ PQR area = 196 cm²

Δ MNT area = 169 cm2

Longest side of PQR = 28 cm

**Concept used:**

According to the Similarity theorem, two triangles are said to be similar, if their sides are in equal proportion along with their corresponding angles. The area of the similar triangle would also be in proportion to the square of their similar sides.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba38cb38fea2385e634cc0353131264f8a31dc295ffd2aac0240a0da835c65bf.png] 

Hence, if Δ ABC ~ Δ DEF

⇒ AB² over DE² = ar Δ ABC over ar Δ DEF 

**Calculations:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c1aaa84b3b167fe1b345c92a65fe4ee7fb0bb47a6047597d893552fe0c6260b.png] **

Longest side of PQR i.e, PR = 28 cm

From the similarity theorem,

⇒ PR²over MT² = ar PQRover ar MNT 

Taking the square root of both the sides -

⇒ 28 over MT = 14over 13

⇒ MT = 26 cm

∴ T**he length of the largest side of the smallest triangle Δ MNT is 26 cm.**

questions.question: A circle with centre O has radius 15 cm. D is a point on the circle such that a 24 cm long chord AB is bisected by OD at point C. Find the length of CD (in cm).
questions.solution:
**Given data:**

OD = OA = 15 cm (radius)

AB = 24 cm

AC = CB = 12 cm

**Concept used:**

Chord theorem circle states that if the radius of the circle is perpendicular to the chord of the circle, it bisects it and vice-versa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b29f64e903c8127e1103dcfe6d7d86da4e0620a9682584366e8ea253b385df64.png] 

In the circle, OA is the radius that bisects the chord BC perpendicularly.

**Calculations:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fbc7599fd58c0595dbd4f3cde90dffa0661e838ef1c2314c69130739273ad0a7.png] **

In right-angled triangle OAC,

AC² + OC² = OA² (From Pythagoras theorem)

Substituting the value of OA and AC 

⇒ OC² = 15² – 12² = 81 or OC = 9 cm

From the figure, CD = OD – OC

Since, OD = radius i.e., 15 cm

⇒ CD = 15 – 9 = 6 cm

∴ **The length of CD is 6 cm.**

questions.question: A shopkeeper earns a profit of 17% on selling a book at 10% discount on the printed price. If the cost price is Rs. 500, then the printed price (in Rs.) is:
questions.solution:
**Given data:**

Profit % = 17%

Discount at Marked Price = 10%

Cost Price = Rs 500

**Formula used:**

MP × (100 - D%) = CP × (100 + G%) = SP

Where-

MP = Marked Price

CP = Cost Price

SP = Selling Price

D% = Discount offered at Marked Price

G% = Profit %

**Calculations:**

Substituting the values of D%, G%, and CP in the equation-

MP × (100 - D%) = CP × (100 + G%)

MP = CP × (100 + G%) / (100 - D%)

MP = 500 × (100+17) / (100 - 90)

MP = 500 × (117 / 90) = Rs 650

**The Printed Price (Marked Price) is Rs 650.**

questions.question: AB is a diameter of a circle with centre O. The tangent at a point C on the circle and AB, when produced, meet at the point P. If ∠APC = 38∘, then what is the measure of ∠PCB?
questions.solution:
**Given data:**

CP = tangent to the circle i.e., ∠OCP = 90º

∠APC = 38º

**Calculations:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55eabb5272c2695ebd12c13a8958acde10f5b4a089cca57ff5abb82b39581e93.png] **

In Δ OCP, ∠OCP + ∠OPC + ∠COP = 180º

∠COP = 180º – (∠OCP + ∠OPC)

∠COP = 180º – (90º + 38º) = 52º

In isosceles triangle BOC, ∠BCO + ∠CBO + ∠COB = 180º

Since ∠BCO = ∠CBO (formed from same radius)

⇒ 2 ∠BCO = 180º – ∠COB

⇒ ∠BCO = (180º - 52º)over 2 = 64º

From the figure, ∠PCB = 90º – ∠BCO

⇒ ∠PCB = 90º – 64º = 26º

∴ **The measure of ∠PCB is 26º.**

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 17,200 is lent out at simple interest in two parts for 2 years at 8% p.a. and 10% p.a., respectively, if the total interest received after 2 years is Rs. 3,008, then the money lent (in Rs.) at the rate of 8% p.a. is:
questions.solution:
**Given data:**

Principal amount = Rs 17,200

Rate 1 = 8 %

Rate 2 = 10 %

Total interest received = Rs 3008

Time = 2 years

**Formula used :**

 SI = (P x R x T) / 100

Where-

P = Principal amount

R = Rate

T = Time

SI = Simple Interest

**Calculation :**

Let the amount lent on 8 % be a

⇒ Amount on 10 % = (17,200 - a)

SI on principal “a” = (a x 8 x 2) / 100 = 4aover 25

Similarly, SI on principal (17,200 - a) = (17,200 - a) × 10 × 2over 100 = 17,200 – a over 5

According to the question, total interest accrued was Rs 3008

⇒ 4aover 25 + 17,200 – a over 5 = 3008

⇒ 4a + 86,000 - 5a = 3008 × 25

⇒ - a + 86,000 = 75,200

⇒ a = Rs 10,800

∴ **The amount lent at 8% rate was Rs 10,800. **

questions.question: In an election between two candidates, 5% of the registered voters did not cast their vote. 10% of the total votes polled were found to be either invalid or of NOTA. The winning candidate received 60% of the total valid votes in his favour and won the election by 17271 votes. Find the number of registered voters.
questions.solution:
**Given data:**

% of voters who did not cast their vote = 5%

Invalid vote percentage = 10%

Winning candidate vote % = 60%

Total vote difference between winning and losing candidate = 17,271 votes

**Calculation:**

Let the total number of voters be a.

Since, 5% of the voters did not cast their vote

⇒ Votes polled = (100 - 5) = 95% of a.

Invalid votes = 10 %

⇒ Total valid votes = 90% × (95% of a).

Votes won by winning candidate = 60 % of 90% of (95% of a).

Votes won by losing candidate = 40 % of 90% of (95% of a).

According to the question-

⇒ 60% of [90% of (95% of a)] − 40% of [90% of (95% of a)] = 17,271

⇒ 20% of [90% of (95% of a)] = 17,271

⇒ 20over 100 × 90over 100 × 95over 100 × a = 17,271

⇒ a = 101,000 votes

∴ **Total registered voters are 101,000. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Let the total number of voters be 100

5% of them did not cast votes

⇒ 100 × 95/100 = 95 casted votes

10% of 95 pressed NOTA

90% of 95 casted votes,

⇒ 90/100 × 95 = 9/2 × 19

Winner gets 60% then looser must be getting 40%

Diiference between them is 60% - 40% = 20%

⇒ 20% of 9/2 × 19 = 17,271

⇒ 1/5 × 9/2 × 19 = 17,271

⇒ 1 = 1010

∴ Total voters = 100 = 100 × 1010 = 1,01,000

questions.question: A manufacturer who marks the price of an article at Rs.1,800, sells it to a dealer at a discount of 15%. The dealer gets a further discount of 8% on his net payment for paying in cash. What amount (to the nearest rupee) does the dealer pay to the manufacturer?
questions.solution:
**Given data:**

Marked Price = Rs 1800

Discount = 15%

Extra discount for paying in cash = 8%

**Formula:**

Effective discount = d₁ + d₂ – d₁ × d₂ over 100

Where d1 and d2 are discount and extra discounts respectively.

SP = MP (1 – Effective discount%)

Where SP and MP are Selling Price and Marked Price.

**Calculations:**

Effective discount = 15 + 8 – 15 times 8 over 100 = 23 – 1.2 = 21.8 %

SP = 18 × (1 - 0.218) = Rs 1408 (rounded off to the nearest rupee).

∴ **The cost paid by dealer to the manufacturer is Rs 1408. **

questions.question: Anup can row 33 km downstream and 35 km upstream in 8 hours. He can also row 44 km downstream and 28 km upstream in the same time. How much time (in hours) will he take to row 55 km downstream and 14 km upstream?
questions.solution:
**Given data:**

 
 

 
 
Downstream distance

 
 
 
Upstream distance

 
 
 
Time

 
 
 

 
 
33 km

 
 
 
35 km

 
 
 
8 hours

 
 
 

 
 
44 km

 
 
 
28 km

 
 
 
8 hours

 
 
 

 
 
55 km

 
 
 
14 km

 
 
 
 

 
 
 

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of river be “x” and speed of boat be “y”.

Effective downstream speed = x + y

Effective upstream speed = x – y

33over x+y+ 35 over x-y = 8 (Eq. 1)

44over x+y + 28over x-y= 8 (Eq. 2)

Subtracting equation 1 from equation 2-

⇒ 44over x+y - 33over x+y + 28over x-y - 35 over x-y= 0

⇒ 44over x+y - 33over x+y = 35 over x-y - 28over x-y

⇒ 11over x+y = 7over x-y

⇒ 11 × (x - y) = 7 × (x + y)

⇒ 11 x - 11y = 7x + 7y

⇒ 4x = 18y

⇒ x = 9over 2y.

Putting the value of "x" in equation 1-

⇒ 33over {9yover 2}+y + 35over {9yover 2}-y = 8

⇒ 66over 11y + 70over 7y = 8 or 6over y + 10 over y = 8

⇒ y = 2 

Substituting the value of "y" in the value of "x" = 9

∴ Time required for 55 km downstream and 14 km upstream distance = 55over x+y+ 14over x-y

⇒ Time required for 55 km downstream and 14 km upstream distance = 55over 9+2+ 14over 9-2= 5 + 2 = 7 hours

**The total time required for the distance to be traveled is 7 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Here, according to the question, 

⇒ 33/(x + y) + 35/(x - y) = 8 & 44/(x + y) + 28/(x - y) = 8

As the number of required hours is a complete number hence 

The values of (x + y) & (x - y) should divide the respective numbers

For Downstream, that is 33 and 44 both are multiples of 11

and for Upstream, that is 35 and 28 both are multiples of 7

By value putting method, 

⇒ 33/11 + 35/7 = 3 + 5 = 8 & 44/11 + 28/7 = 4 + 4 = 8

⇒ x + y = 11 & x - y = 7

Required time, 

⇒ 55/11 + 14/7 = 5 + 2 = 7 hours

∴ The total time required for the distance to be traveled is 7 hours.

questions.question: LCM of two number is 22 times their HCF. If one of the numbers is 132 and the sum of LCM and HCF is 276, then what is the other number?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of HCF : LCM = 1 : 22

Total units = 1 + 22 = 23 units

23 units = 276 ⇒ 1 unit (HCF) = 12

LCM = 22 × 12 = 264

Other number = (LCM × HCF) ÷ Given number = (264 × 12) ÷ 132 = 24

**∴ The correct answer is 24.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

LCM = 22 × HCF

LCM + HCF = 276

First number = 132

**Formula Used:**

Product of two numbers = LCM × HCF

 
 HCF (1x)
 
 LCM (22x)
 
• 
 Total Sum = 276
 132 × Other Number = HCF × LCM

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let HCF = H

⇒ LCM = 22H

⇒ H + 22H = 276

⇒ 23H = 276

⇒ H = 276 ÷ 23 = 12

⇒ LCM = 22 × 12 = 264

⇒ 132 × Other Number = 12 × 264

⇒ Other Number = (12 × 264) ÷ 132

⇒ Other Number = 12 × 2 = 24

**∴ The correct answer is 24.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF and LCM Relation

For any two numbers a and b, HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b) = a × b.

HCF and LCM of Fractions

HCF = (HCF of Numerators) ÷ (LCM of Denominators) and LCM = (LCM of Numerators) ÷ (HCF of Denominators).

Co-prime Numbers

Two numbers are co-prime if their HCF is 1. In this case, their LCM is simply the product of the numbers.</p

questions.question: Three years ago, the ratio of the age of father to that of his son was 8 ∶ 3. After 4 years, their ages will be in the ratio 11 ∶ 5. What is the present age (in years) of the father?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of father and son age = 8 : 3

Ratio after 4 years = 11 : 5

**Calculations:**

Let the age of Father and Son three years before "8a" and "3a"

Age of Father and Son after 4 years from 3 years past = (8a + 7) and (3a + 7)

According to the question-

⇒ 8a+7over 3a+7 = 11over 5

⇒ 40a + 35 = 33a + 77 

⇒ 7a = 42

⇒ a = 6

∴ Present age of Father = (8a + 3) = 8 × 6 + 3 = 51 years

**∴ the present age of Father is 51 years.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**Age ratio three years ago = 8 : 3

Age ratio (4 + 3) i.e. 7 years after = 11 : 5

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b339dfae03e2344cb8f16351bbc73c7a6b014c54b2beb401bf53cea8a14c444d.png] 

Let the common ratio be Q.

40Q - 33Q = 77 - 35

⇒ 7Q = 42

⇒ Q = 6

⇒ 8Q = 48

⇒ 8Q + 3 = 51

Now, the present age of father = 51 years

∴ The present age of the father is 51 years.
